Website privacy

This page describes the PaperPocket download and support website. The Android app has its own app privacy policy.

What this website does

This static website presents app information, screenshots, download links and support guidance. Its code does not add analytics, advertising scripts, accounts, document uploads or a server-side feedback database. Browser PDF tools are not offered on this version.

Feedback and clipboard

The feedback form prepares an email draft in your chosen email app. You review and send it there. This website does not send or store the report. Copy buttons request clipboard access only to copy the checksum or report you selected. Form fields are not saved in local storage by this site's code.

Hosting and downloads

The website is hosted with Sites. The hosting provider receives the technical web requests needed to serve the site and may apply its own access and privacy controls. Download and source links open GitHub, which receives requests under its own policies. External email and GitHub issue submissions use those providers' services. This page does not make a claim about their logging or retention.

Contact

For website privacy or support, contact murtazaofficialskardu@gmail.com. Please avoid including private documents, passwords or sensitive personal information.
